Ava (AE): Kicking off OrbitAnalytics POC intake. They want a 10-business-day POC to validate semantic search + cost. Proposed kickoff Thu 09:30 CET.
Marco (SE): Thu 09:30 ok. Their asks?
Ava (AE): Goals: Replace vendor search, Recall@10 >= 0.78, p95 latency <= 350ms, cost <= 50% of current. EU data residency and SSO required.
Dana (Eng): We'll start on hosted for quick baseline then Dedicated for final runs. Need their labeled eval set (3-8k items) and traffic profile.
Ivy (Security): Send SSQ v3 and DFD by Day2. Confirm no PHI and whether logs must be forwarded to their SIEM. KMS likely requested.
Theo (CS): I'll set up demo sandbox and invite PO, Data Lead, and Sec reviewer. Pricing questions: they want committed vs burst options. I'll prepare a delta.
Marco (SE): Operational notes: create trial project in EU, scoped API key, pin model rwd-embed-v2 for search, enable prefix cache, set batch size 8. I'll add runbook snippets in shared drive.
Ava (AE): Kickoff agenda (30m): 1) intros 2) use-case + success criteria 3) data & security checklist 4) timeline & owners 5) open issues.
Dana (Eng): Success criteria to capture: a) p95 <= 350ms at 20qps b) Recall@10 >= 0.78 on their eval c) cost per 10k queries <= target we'll compute.
Ivy (Security): Blockers: DPA for EU, SSO IdP metadata, completed SSQ. On-prem will add 6-8 weeks.
Theo (CS): Action items: Ava confirm DPA timeline & collect invite list (due EOD). Marco infra runbook + eval harness (due Wed AM). Ivy SSQ kickoff (due Tue). Theo pricing delta + demo link (due EOD today).
